skills.does: Explain what a cron schedule expression means in plain English.
examples: what does this cron expression mean

skills.does: Escape special characters so text matches literally inside a regex pattern.
examples: escape this for a regex: a.b
escape a path for a pattern

skills.does: Look up what an HTTP status code means.
Decode the header and claims inside a JSON Web Token.
examples: read the claims in this jwt

skills.does: Look up the MIME type for a file extension, or which extensions use a MIME type.
examples: what mime type is a png

skills.does: Split one version number into major, minor, patch and pre-release.
Run a regex pattern over sample text and show every hit it makes.
examples: test this regex against my text
check a regex that finds nothing

skills.does: Look up a character by symbol, code point or name, with its encodings.
Decode plain base64 back into readable text — un-base64 a string.
Encode text as base64.
Read a run of 1s and 0s back into the message it spells.
examples: turn these bits back into text

skills.does: Write text out as 1s and 0s, eight bits to a byte.
Shift every letter along the alphabet by a fixed amount, as a Caesar cipher.
Squash text down into a shorter base64 string to store or send.
Unpack a compressed base64 blob back into the text it came from.
Generate a memorable passphrase from random words.
examples: make a memorable password from words
passphrase with six words separated by dots

skills.does: Generate a random string of a given length from a character set you choose.
examples: generate a random code people can read out

skills.does: Generate a UUID — a GUID, a v4 random identifier — one or several.
Work out the SHA hash of a piece of text.
Read hex byte values back as the characters they stand for.
Write text out as hexadecimal byte values.
examples: hex encode with spaces between bytes

skills.does: Read dots and dashes back as the words they spell.
examples: decode morse with a word break

skills.does: Write words out as Morse dots and dashes.
Apply the ROT13 letter substitution, which is its own reverse.
examples: what does Uryyb say in rot13

skills.does: Turn %20-style escapes back into readable characters.
Percent-escape text so it survives inside a web address.
examples: encode this for a query string

skills.does: Rank several sizes or packs by value for money and say which is cheapest per unit.
examples: which is better value, 500ml for 1.20 or 1.5l for 3.30
is the bigger box cheaper per kilo

skills.does: Convert a cooking measure between cups, spoons, millilitres and grams, using the ingredient to get weight right.
examples: how many grams is 2 cups of flour

skills.does: Work out the fuel cost of a journey from distance, consumption and fuel price.
examples: fuel cost for a 500km trip at 7.5 litres per 100km and 1.65 a litre
how much fuel for 320 km at 6.2 L per 100
petrol cost for 300 miles at 32 mpg

skills.does: Multiply every ingredient amount in a recipe by a factor, rounded to sensible kitchen fractions.
examples: double this recipe: 2 cups flour, 1 egg, 3/4 tsp salt
halve these: 1 cup sugar, 2 tbsp butter, 4 eggs
scale by 1.5: 500 g pasta, 200 ml cream

skills.does: Total a basket — items, postage, free-delivery thresholds and tax.
Add a tip to a bill and split it between people, to the exact penny.
examples: split a 84.50 bill four ways with 15% tip

skills.does: Take one discount off after another — an extra 15% off an already reduced price — and show the real saving.
Work out the price per unit — per litre, per kilo, per item — so sizes can be compared.
examples: what is the price per litre of 2.4 litres for 3.60
cost per item for a pack of 12 at 5.99

skills.does: Say what kind of file an extension is and which media type it uses.
Turn a number of bytes into a readable file size like 1.4 MB.
examples: make 1073741824 bytes readable in binary units
what is 512 bytes as a file size

skills.does: Count the lines, words and bytes in a piece of text and describe its line endings.
examples: count the lines in this file
file stats with a blank line

skills.does: Work out the monthly payment and total interest on a loan.
examples: monthly payment on a 200000 mortgage at 5 percent over 30 years
repayments on a 15000 car loan at 7.5% over 5 years

skills.does: Take a single percentage or amount off one price and show what you save.
